name: Agents village
author: agents-ui
description: The agents-tui village in the Omarchy bar: how many agents are working, what waits on you, and each swarm's houses, gate and pipeline in a panel.

barWidget.description: Live swarm status from an agents-tui server: the swarms, then one village's houses, flow, what needs you and its features. Right-click opens the full village; middle-click joins the swarm.

schema.label: Server
schema.description: The agents-tui web server. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:7890, where agents-tui listens. Set another URL to reach a server on a different host.

schema.label: Village
schema.description: A swarm's project name to always show. Empty: start at the list of swarms (or the only one).

schema.label: Red dot when something needs you
Machine
schema.description: The swarm's machine for Join swarm (swarm <machine>, from remote-swarm-setup.sh), e.g. box. Empty hides the button. A plain host name only.

schema.label: Notify when something needs you
schema.description: One notification when something starts waiting on you. The desktop notifier (install.sh --notify) does this instead while it is installed.
